description:
Update a unit by id.

Rules:
- Partial update: pass the id plus ONLY the fields to change; everything you leave out keeps its stored value. Lists you do send (steps, tiers, entitlements) are the complete new list. Active state isn't an update field — use the archive / unarchive tools.
- Changing `agentKey` re-points which runtime signals map here — do it deliberately.

agentKey.description: Lowercased stable key consumption is reported against (sent as `agentKey` when recording unit usage). The unit's durable identity — unique org-wide, chars [a-z0-9._-]; a rename never changes it.

flatPrice.description: FLAT only: price per event. Default 0.

pricingType.description: FLAT = a single per-event price. SLAB/VOLUME = tiered pricing.

tiers.description: SLAB/VOLUME only: 1–50 tiers, ordered by rising upTo; the last one (and only it) has upTo:null.

upTo.description: Upper bound of this tier (whole number, rising tier by tier). The LAST tier must be null ('and above'), and only the last.
